summary: load_config no longer swallows parse failures; it now propagates the parse exception to callers.

items.title: Parse failures now propagate from load_config
items.before: If parsing raised inside load_config, the except branch returned an empty dictionary, hiding the parse error from callers.
items.after: If parsing raises inside load_config, the except branch re-raises the exception, so callers receive the parse error instead of {}.
